local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local Client = Players.LocalPlayer
getgenv().AutoArmor = true

-- / Auto Location
BuyPads = nil
for i,v in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do if v.Name == '[Medium Armor]' then BuyPads = v.Parent break end end

-- / Auto Armor
task.spawn(function()
    while wait(.3) do
        if getgenv().AutoArmor then
            pcall(function()
                if Client.Character:GetAttribute("Armor") < 100 then
                    pcall(function() fireclickdetector(BuyPads["[High-Medium Armor]"]:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector"), 1) end)
                    pcall(function() fireclickdetector(BuyPads["[Medium Armor]"]:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector"), 1) end)
                end
            end)
        end
     end
end)
